script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Neptune is squared by Mars, stirring tension in your 7th House of Partnerships. Beware: a Mercury‑Mars square in your 3rd House could cause miscommunication in contracts. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
